parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented bathroom, custody, border-document or police-targeting exposure reaching visitors, and the dossier records no pattern of anti-trans violence against travellers. Prosecutorial guidance treats gender-identity hostility as aggravating — a real, if rarely-invoked, recourse signal. Against that: a conservative society (public affection discouraged, no queer scene), no SOGI anti-discrimination or hate-crime statute, a 2024 marriage amendment (resident-facing, general-LGB — weighted lightly), and a 2024 cabinet direction to draft a policy banning LGBTQIA+ advocacy and promotion, which frames gender diversity as contrary to national and religious values. That direction bears mainly on resident organising; its legal form and enforcement are unsourced, so it is an open question, not a documented universal exposure. No tier-1 or tier-2 feature exists. Sits at the top of the Reduced Risk band, below jurisdictions with demonstrated service protection.
